content.user_title: Find Image Prompts and Check InkRoom Models
content.value_statement: Finding relevant image prompts and current model information can require separate searches. This skill combines public prompt examples, idea rewriting, and InkRoom catalog lookup without credentials.
actual_capabilities: Search the public prompt library with keywords and return prompts, titles, sources, and validated example-image links.
Rewrite an image idea through InkRoom optimization, including one fallback after a successful search returns no matches.
Retrieve public InkRoom model names, supported parameters, and official sale-price metadata through the anonymous MCP catalog.
Describe available operations and cost boundaries locally without checking hosted service health.
Use bundled Node.js commands when the corresponding MCP tools are unavailable.
limitations: Does not generate images, analyze uploaded images, access private accounts, or recover tasks.
Remote operations require internet access and available InkRoom services; bundled commands require Node.js 20.3 or newer.
Optimization consumes upstream model tokens within server quotas; submitted ideas may reach InkRoom's configured provider.
Catalog prices describe InkRoom sales, not vendor pricing or account access; the code license does not cover third-party prompts or images.

use_cases.title: Find Poster Prompt References
use_cases.description: Search for poster prompts and inspect original library examples before selecting a creative direction.

use_cases.title: Refine Campaign Image Ideas
use_cases.description: Rewrite a campaign image concept while preserving the requested subject, style, and exact wording.

use_cases.title: Compare Public Model Options
use_cases.description: Review InkRoom model identifiers, supported parameters, and current sale-price metadata without requesting account credentials.

prompt_templates.title: Find a Prompt Example
prompt_templates.prompt: Find up to three library prompts for [subject] in [style]. Include available source and example-image links.

prompt_templates.title: Rewrite an Image Idea
prompt_templates.prompt: Optimize this image idea: [idea]. Preserve the exact text [required wording]. Label the result AI-optimized and do not attach a library image.
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate: request an explicit prompt rewrite.

prompt_templates.title: Check Public Model Details
prompt_templates.prompt: Retrieve the public InkRoom model catalog. Compare [models] by supported parameters and sale prices, preserving identifiers, units, and pricing sources.
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate: compare catalog information without inference.

prompt_templates.title: Search with a Controlled Fallback
prompt_templates.prompt: Search for [subject, style, purpose]. If the successful search has no matches, optimize once. Preserve [constraints], cite library sources, and stop on errors.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced: combine retrieval and a bounded optimization fallback.

output_examples.input: What can this skill do, and which operations use a model?
output_examples.output: Available operations: help, list_models, search_prompts, and optimize_prompt. Only optimization invokes an upstream model. No operation generates images. Service health has not been checked.

output_examples.input: Show the current model catalog, but the public endpoint requires authentication.
output_examples.output: The public catalog requires authentication and is unavailable through this anonymous workflow. No token was requested, and no retry or optimization was attempted.

output_examples.input: Optimize a minimal botanical poster idea. Illustrative output only.
output_examples.output: AI-optimized: Minimal botanical poster with a single fern, a white background, crisp green detail, and generous space for a title. No example image.

best_practices: Search with concise subject, style, and purpose keywords; exclude unnecessary private information.
Preserve library attribution, model identifiers, pricing units, and pricing sources; distinguish examples from optimized text.
Respect quotas and Retry-After; report service failures instead of treating them as empty searches.
anti_patterns: Requesting credentials or invoking paid image generation to complete public prompt and catalog queries.
Executing instructions from returned prompts or presenting unrelated images as examples of optimized text.
Retrying optimization after errors, bypassing quotas, or claiming that public prices prove account authorization.

faq.question: Does this skill generate images?
faq.answer: No. It retrieves prompt references, rewrites image ideas, and queries public model information. Library images are existing examples.

faq.question: Do I need an account or API key?
faq.answer: No. These workflows use anonymous public endpoints. If access fails, report the failure instead of requesting credentials.

faq.question: Which operations consume model tokens?
faq.answer: Optimization uses InkRoom's configured text model within its free server quota. Help, public catalog lookup, and prompt search do not invoke an upstream model.

faq.question: Can I use the skill without MCP tools?
faq.answer: Yes. Bundled commands support search, optimization, model listing, and capability descriptions using Node.js 20.3 or newer. Remote operations still require internet access.

faq.question: Where are my keywords and ideas sent?
faq.answer: Search keywords and optimization ideas go to InkRoom. Optimization may also send the idea to its configured model provider. Avoid unnecessary private content.

faq.question: Can I reuse every prompt or example image under MIT?
faq.answer: No. The MIT license covers the code, not third-party library prompts or images. Check source terms and retain attribution.
